text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Central bank weekly foreign exchange auctions moved to Abuja from Lagos.
- Drugs bought with 1.5 billion naira from Petroleum Trust Fund may be delivered to public hospitals next week.
- Elf Production Nigeria announces $0.38 per barrel drop in crude oil production costs below the $2.30 per barrel industry average.
- Court order scuppers plans by state-run Nigerian Telecommunications to repair burnt telephone exchange by demanding special levies from customers.
